items.html: And there are two corrections in the Rosh, and they are the two ears and the two eyes, and the forehead stands between them, for it is below the ears and higher than the eyes, and it is the aspect of the Yesod of Atik, hidden in the forehead. And the NH in the two ears and in the two eyes, which are in the two discernments of Netzach and Hod, as mentioned. And this is the matter of the NH being called the aspect of the eyes.
